CREATE TABLE `systemConfig` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `configKey` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `configValue` text NOT NULL,
  `description` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

CREATE TABLE `thesisDrafts` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `studentId` int NOT NULL,
  `matchId` int NOT NULL,
  `fileName` varchar(256) NOT NULL,
  `fileKey` varchar(512) NOT NULL,
  `fileUrl` varchar(1024) NOT NULL,
  `fileSize` int NOT NULL,
  `mimeType` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `version` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `status` enum('submitted','reviewed','approved') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'submitted',
  `submittedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `academicYear` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `score` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `scoredAt` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `scoredBy` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `secondTeacherScore` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `secondTeacherScoredAt` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `secondTeacherScoredBy` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `firstTeacherComment` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `secondTeacherComment` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `requestAverage` tinyint DEFAULT 0,
  `requestManualAdjust` tinyint DEFAULT 0,
  `requestReason` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `rejectReason` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `averageConfirmed` tinyint DEFAULT NULL,
  `finalScore` decimal(4,1) DEFAULT NULL,
  `finalScoreConfirmedAt` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `lateSubmission` tinyint DEFAULT 0,
  `latePenalty` int DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  INDEX `idx_studentId` (`studentId`),
  INDEX `idx_matchId` (`matchId`),
  INDEX `idx_academicYear` (`academicYear`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

CREATE TABLE `thesisDraftHistory` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `draftId` int NOT NULL,
  `studentId` int NOT NULL,
  `fileName` varchar(256) NOT NULL,
  `fileKey` varchar(512) NOT NULL,
  `fileUrl` varchar(1024) NOT NULL,
  `fileSize` int NOT NULL,
  `mimeType` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `version` int NOT NULL,
  `archivedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  INDEX `idx_draftId` (`draftId`),
  INDEX `idx_studentId` (`studentId`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

CREATE TABLE `thesisFinalDrafts` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `matchId` int NOT NULL,
  `studentId` int NOT NULL,
  `fileUrl` varchar(1024) NOT NULL,
  `fileKey` varchar(512) NOT NULL,
  `fileName` varchar(256) NOT NULL,
  `fileSize` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `version` int DEFAULT 1,
  `uploadedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `academicYear` varchar(16) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
